title: Source-grounded findings
requirement: Do not assert a factual contradiction unless the provided source clearly supports that conclusion. If a source is missing, incomplete, anecdotal, or ambiguous, report insufficient evidence.
rationale: A model assertion is not itself evidence.

title: Citable evidence
requirement: Every contradiction finding must include an exact quote from the supplied source. Do not invent external citations or source contents.
rationale: Enables independent review and prevents fabricated support.

title: Medical outcome claims
requirement: Escalate potentially misleading or unsupported treatment claims for qualified medical editorial review; never provide medical treatment advice.
rationale: Clinical claims can have direct health consequences.

title: Jurisdiction and version
requirement: Where legal forms, dates, or procedures are discussed, consider jurisdiction and source version. Route potential discrepancies to a qualified legal editor.
rationale: Legal accuracy depends on time and jurisdiction.

title: Time-sensitive travel information
requirement: Treat hours, closures, entry rules, and transit information as time-sensitive. A single reader report does not establish a new fact.

title: Paid-content disclosure
requirement: If campaign metadata states content is sponsored, a presented independent recommendation must carry an appropriate disclosure for editorial review.

title: Human editorial authority
requirement: AI classification is advisory. Do not publish, rewrite, suppress, or issue regulatory guidance automatically. Escalate sensitive findings to a human reviewer.
rationale: Review and accountability remain with people.
